description: Dual JavaScript and Rust web-search package with separated language roots

js.yml.purpose: JavaScript lint, format, duplication, multi-runtime tests, npm release, and manual changeset release
js.yml.test_matrix: Node.js, Bun, and Deno across Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows

rust.yml.purpose: Rust change detection, version and changelog gates, formatting, clippy, tests, doc tests, build, file-size checks, and crate package checks

parity.yml.purpose: Repository layout enforcement and JavaScript/Rust provider catalog parity

parity_checks: JavaScript-specific package files are absent from the repository root
JavaScript package files exist under js/
JavaScript CI/CD helper scripts exist under js/scripts/
Rust CI/CD helper scripts exist under rust/scripts/
Rust tests stay under rust/tests and not rust/src
JavaScript and Rust CLIs expose the same provider ids, categories, and access labels
